title: docs-notes
subHeroTitle: A unified document canvas, cloud asset hub, and AI workspace
subHeroDesc: Meet Motion. Write structured block documents, store cloud files, collaborate in real time with granular security, sync bi-directionally with Notion, and automate your wiki with an inline AI writing partner and autonomous page management.

sections.title: A rich block canvas with nested page and folder hierarchies
sections.desc: Write structured documents on a customizable TipTap editor with crash-proof auto-saving. Organize your knowledge base using nested pages, subpages, folders, and S3 cloud asset uploads.

gridItems.title: Rich TipTap Block Canvas
gridItems.desc: Write comfortably using text, headings, bullet lists, block quotes, tables, and syntax-highlighted code blocks built on a customizable TipTap editor environment.

gridItems.title: Local Storage Auto-Save Protection
gridItems.desc: Never lose a single keystroke. All document changes automatically save in real time to local storage to protect against accidental browser crashes or connection drops.

gridItems.title: Pages & Subpages Hierarchy
gridItems.desc: Build deep knowledge bases and structured team wikis with infinite nesting of main pages and nested subpages.

gridItems.title: Folders & Subfolders Structure
gridItems.desc: Organize documents, project briefs, and external files cleanly using multi-tier folders and subfolders.

gridItems.title: Flexible Import & Export Engine
gridItems.desc: Import external documents smoothly and export your Motion pages into standard file formats like Markdown, HTML, and PDF with one click.

sections.title: Cloud asset previews, granular permissions, and live team co-editing
sections.desc: Upload media directly to Amazon S3, control access with granular role permissions, co-edit in real-time with live cursor tracking, and collaborate using inline comment threads and analytics.

gridItems.title: S3 Cloud Uploads & Previews
gridItems.desc: Upload PDFs, Word docs, slide decks, high-res images, and videos directly to Amazon S3 with automatic format scanning and color-coded type tag previews.

gridItems.title: Sharing & Granular Permissions
gridItems.desc: Share documents securely using Private invite-only mode, Space team access, or public web links with granular roles like Full Access, Can Edit, or Can View.

gridItems.title: Real-Time Concurrent Co-Editing & Comments
gridItems.desc: Co-edit simultaneously with active cursor tracking, selection threads, block inline text comments, and 28-day document activity analytics.

gridItems.title: 2-Way Notion Integration
gridItems.desc: Connect Notion via 1-click OAuth to import/export documents and auto-convert blocks bi-directionally using Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution.

sections.title: Streaming AI writing partner and hands-free page automation
sections.desc: Leverage an inline AI assistant for document rewrites, summaries, and translations, while letting autonomous AI agents create, update, and delete Motion pages directly.

gridItems.title: Streaming AI Writing Partner
gridItems.desc: Highlight any paragraph or text block to prompt the AI assistant for instant rewrites, tone adjustments, translations, or summaries streamed live onto your document canvas.

gridItems.title: Instant AI Page Summaries
gridItems.desc: Condensed AI summary engine that extracts core takeaways, action items, and technical decisions from lengthy Motion documents on demand.

gridItems.title: Autonomous Motion Page Operations
gridItems.desc: Direct natural language AI capabilities to create new pages, update existing document content, link notes to active sprint tasks, or delete obsolete wiki pages hands-free.

capabilitiesDesc: Forget isolated documentation silos. Motion integrates rich-text block editing directly to active tasks and space permissions.
checklistDesc: Unify product specifications, team guides, and meeting transcripts inside one integrated knowledge canvas.
checklistItems: Rich TipTap Block Canvas: Write comfortably using text, headings, bullet lists, block quotes, tables, and syntax-highlighted code blocks built on a customizable TipTap editor environment.,
Local Storage Auto-Save Protection: Safeguard your work against browser crashes or network dropouts with instant real-time auto-saving stored directly in local storage.,
Pages & Subpages Hierarchy: Construct structured team wikis, technical documentation, and product roadmaps with unlimited nesting of pages and subpages.,
Folders & Subfolders Directory: Group related documents, sprint specs, and media assets side-by-side inside multi-tier folders and subfolders.,
Seamless Import & Export Capabilities: Effortlessly import existing documents and export your Motion pages into Markdown, HTML, and PDF formats for frictionless sharing.,

Share Links & Granular Role Permissions: Manage document visibility with Private invite-only access, Space team permissions, or public web links, configured with Full Access, Can Edit, or Can View roles.,
Amazon S3 Cloud Uploads & Previews: Upload PDFs, Word documents, slide decks, images, and videos directly to secure S3 storage, featured alongside format scanning and color-coded type tag previews.,

Real-Time Co-Editing & Inline Comments: Co-author documents live with team members featuring real-time multiplayer cursors, inline text comments, selection threads, and 28-day document view analytics.,
Streaming AI Writing Assistant: Select any text block on your canvas and trigger the AI writing partner to stream instant rewrites, translations, or stylistic improvements in real time.,
2-Way Notion Integration: Link your Notion workspace via 1-click OAuth to import/export documents and synchronize blocks bidirectionally using Last-Write-Wins update logic.,
Collaborative Commenting & Threading: Leave granular inline text comments and selection feedback threads directly on document blocks to streamline team review cycles.,
Autonomous AI Motion Page Management: Command AI agents to summarize document contents, create new pages, update existing notes, or delete deprecated wiki pages using simple natural language.
